name: rhomboid 5 homolog 2

function.text: RHBDF2 encodes inactive rhomboid protein 2. Annotated molecular activities include cargo receptor activity. It participates in regulation of protein secretion and negative regulation of protein secretion.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to palmoplantar keratoderma-esophageal carcinoma syndrome (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
